news.built: Have you seen the new {building}? Finished just now.
They've finished the {building}. Took long enough!

news.built.text: The {building} is done, and a fine job we made of it, if I say so myself.
A new {building}! {settlement} is coming up in the world.
Another {building}. More hammering at dawn, I suppose.
Everyone's talking about the new {building}. Go and look!

news.stalled: The builders are sat on their hands for want of {goods}. If you've any to sell, the town would pay well.

news.stalled.text: No {goods}, no walls. We need about {amount} more.
If someone brought us {goods}, the whole town would thank them.
Short of {goods}, they say. A clever trader could make a fortune.

news.tier: Did you hear? {settlement} is a {tier} now!
We're a proper {tier} these days. Imagine that.

news.tier.text: A {tier}! My grandmother wouldn't believe it.
A {tier} means more mouths and more noise. Still, I suppose it's progress.

news.arrived: There's a new face in town: {other}.
{other} has come to live with us. Say hello if you see them.

news.arrived.text: A baby! {other}, they're calling it. Isn't that lovely?

news.died: We lost {other}. The town's quieter for it.
Poor {other}. We buried them by the old wall.

news.died.text: {other} is with the hearth now. Say a word for them, if you would.

news.left: A few of ours packed up and went off to found {other}. Too many of us and not enough roofs, that's what it was.
Some of the young ones left with a cart and a plough. {other}, they're calling the place.

news.left.text: They've gone to found {other}. I'd have gone myself, twenty years ago.
Off to found {other}, the lot of them! I'll miss the noise.

news.founded: We're new here. Every stone you see, we set ourselves.
news.none: Nothing much happens here, and that's how we like it.
Same as ever. Bread, work, sleep.

news.none.text: Quiet times. Too quiet, if you ask me.
Not a whisper of news. I'll have to make some up.
The crops are in and the roof doesn't leak. What more is there?
